Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using DDA and label-free quantification (MaxQuant/Perseus). While the biological study focuses on ubiquitination, the proteomics runs described in the methods and PRIDE metadata are for identifying complex members via pull-downs, not for enriching ubiquitin-remnant peptides (no diGly/K-GG antibodies mentioned for the MS runs).

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiments (affinity purifications) were used to define the composition of the RNF185/MBRL complex, comparing the interactomes of the bait proteins (RNF185, MBRL) against controls (HRD1) and across different genetic backgrounds (KO cells). While Tunicamycin and CB-5083 are mentioned in the text, they were used for qPCR and fluorescence/turnover assays, not as the primary variable for the MS-analyzed samples.
